_meta.tdd: gates-first: every accept command FAILS against current main (verified RED before dispatch)

tasks.title: Synapse appservice registration: app_service_config_files + templated intercom.yaml + init-config render + sealed synapse-appservice Secret
tasks.accept: nix build .#scs-manifests 2>&1 | tail -3 && ls result/30-synapse.yaml && grep -q 'app_service_config_files' result/30-synapse.yaml && grep -q 'intercom.yaml' result/30-synapse.yaml && grep -q '__MATRIX_AS_TOKEN__' result/30-synapse.yaml && grep -q '__MATRIX_HS_TOKEN__' result/30-synapse.yaml && grep -q 'sender_localpart' result/30-synapse.yaml && grep -q 'synapse-appservice' result/30-synapse.yaml && grep -q 'matrix-hs-token' result/30-synapse.yaml && ! grep -n 'tag = "latest"' platform/kubernetes/services/synapse.nix
tasks.acceptance_prose: per plan/2026-08-16-matrix-appservice-plan.md MA-1: homeserverConfig gains app_service_config_files ['/config/appservice/intercom.yaml']; synapse-config ConfigMap gains key appservice/intercom.yaml (id intercom, hs_token __MATRIX_HS_TOKEN__, as_token __MATRIX_AS_TOKEN__, sender_localpart intercom, non-exclusive users regex @.*); init-config renders both homeserver.yaml and the registration from mounted secrets; config-src items include the new key; new lib.secret synapse-appservice (opendesk ns, keys matrix-as-token + matrix-hs-token, placeholder values sealed at build); deployment mounts the new secret; no :latest tag

tasks.acceptance_prose: per plan MA-2: NEW scripts/e2e-appservice.mjs — Node acceptance test: (1) manifest assertions on result/30-synapse.yaml (app_service_config_files, intercom.yaml, __MATRIX_AS_TOKEN__/__MATRIX_HS_TOKEN__ placeholders, synapse-appservice, sender_localpart), (2) live m.login.application_service login to https://matrix.home.opendesk-edu.org/_matrix/client/v3/login with Bearer MATRIX_AS_SECRET + user from E2E_MATRIX_USER (default testuser) asserting 200 + access_token; exit 0 manifest-only when MATRIX_AS_SECRET unset; exit non-zero with clear message otherwise
